FIRST, THE DOMAIN

text: What is commodity trading?
textPreview: What is commodity trading?

text: It is buying and selling physical goods whose prices change in the market.
textPreview: It is buying and selling physical goods whose prices change in the market.

text: Examples
textPreview: Examples

text: Cocoa, coffee, grain and fuel are commodities.
textPreview: Cocoa, coffee, grain and fuel are commodities.

text: The deal
textPreview: The deal

text: A trader buys a quantity, then may sell it in parts over time.

text: Source: product/commodity_trading/ele_trading/README.md, sections 1, 2 and 5. Odoo 19 analytic-account documentation: https://www.odoo.com/documentation/19.0/applications/finance/accounting/reporting/analytic_accounting.html. Analytic accounts summarize attributed costs and revenue from accounting entries. The optional Trade Budget addon has an analytic account field documented as intended for future accounting integration; this slide does not claim that the Trade automatically populates an analytic account.
